svg.text: TPS23881RTQR, 8 channels, one channel per RJ45 (2-pair Alt-A, pairs 1-2 positive and 3-6 negative).
RSENSE is 0.200 ohm (not 0.255). SDAI tied to SDAO. A4:A1 strapped low -> 7-bit address 0x20 in 16-bit config B.
Leave every NC and TEST pin open. AGND, DGND, and the exposed pad all go to GND.
Kelvin: route KSENSA to the GND pads of RS1 and RS2 only. Same idea for KSENSB/C/D. Do not use a random ground via.
Port FETs, 0.200 ohm sense resistors, fuses, and port TVS are on sheets 05 and 06.
The gate pin goes straight to the MOSFET gate. No gate pulldown. Leakage must stay under 250 nA.
KS_A touches the GND pads of ports 1 and 2 only. Same pattern for KS_B, KS_C, and KS_D.
